content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(CDR-009 Anomalous East-West Connection Spike from Baselined Microservice) AND ABIOC(CDR-009 Anomalous Container Process-Tree Deviation from Learned Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations into a single microservices-anomaly incident with the privileged-exec causality chain.
rules.name: Sock-Shop Microservices Behavioral Anomaly — ABIOC Causality Stitch
